text: XX/XX/XXXX, XXXX Made the check amount for my rent {$880.00} XXXX XXXX says the check was deposited into my landlords account, no one has the time that she deposited it. I asked again, if it takes XXXX days, and she deposited the check on the XXXX, and I had the funds to cover my insufficient funds within hours, why was the check returned?
